oracleScope: The isolated packaged oracle exercises owned page, lane and retention transitions under the bundled unsuppressed ownership analyzer. Failed arena initialization uses its own lexical owner; reuse ends lease scopes before reset and scoped batches recycle in finally. Entered initializer snapshots, real registered provider ranges, actual representation and saturation are independently verified by local tests; the package program does not capture a linear owner in a callback.
availability: Every listed field is implemented, including when tracing is off. Captures require the owning thread; preparation snapshots reject unprepared owners instead of returning fabricated zeros. Zero is a real gauge or documented invariant, not unavailable telemetry.
unreviewedScope: These 45 fields do not close owner statistics, owner diagnostics, typed layouts, trace events, complete API/lifecycle coverage, benefit evidence, platform validation or final release gates.

schemas.scope: One fixed-shape thread-confined pool. Known full page extents are native backing; bank element bytes exclude CLR headers and array overhead. Usable unused slots exclude stride padding and live-slot slack.
schemas.consistency: A complete capture on the owning thread; entered initializer captures include initializing occupancy but not a successful publication. Capture itself does not grant lease authority.
schemas.resetPolicy: No reset. Trim reduces actual retained pages and usable slots but cannot refill them or shrink the metadata arrays. Disposal clears native gauges while original preparation, bank storage, peaks and event histories remain observable.
schemas.historyOverflow: Event histories saturate with the owner-wide sticky flag; exact occupancy, backing and metadata gauges do not depend on subtracting saturated histories.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Stable non-address allocator lineage, unchanged by trim and disposal.
fields.overflow: Owner construction rejects non-wrapping identity exhaustion.

fields.name: Lifecycle
fields.definition: Actual owner lifecycle, not inferred from retained bytes.
fields.overflow: Finite lifecycle; cleanup does not resurrect authority.

fields.name: Preparation
fields.definition: Immutable original slot count, element capacity and maximum slots per page; never relabeled after trim.
fields.overflow: Positive checked constructor dimensions and backing arithmetic.

fields.name: RetainedPageCount
fields.definition: Actual nonzero page allocations retained now; a live slot keeps its complete page.
fields.overflow: Bounded by immutable allocated page bank length.

fields.name: RetainedSlotCount
fields.definition: All slots belonging to still-backed pages, including a shorter final page; trimmed slots cannot be reused.
fields.overflow: Bounded by original positive Int32 slot count.

fields.name: OccupiedSlotCount
fields.definition: Initializing and published active leases, excluding returned slots and failed initialization after rollback.
fields.overflow: Exact gauge bounded by retained slots; not reconstructed from history.

fields.name: PeakOccupiedSlotCount
fields.definition: Actual lifetime simultaneous initializing-or-published occupancy high-water, even if initialization later fails.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum within prepared slot bound.

fields.name: AvailableSlotCount
fields.definition: Still-backed slots minus initializing and published occupancy, not original slots minus successful rent history.
fields.overflow: Exact nonnegative bounded difference.

fields.name: RetainedBytes
fields.definition: Complete physically retained page extents, including per-slot 64-byte stride padding; not RSS or live payload bytes.
fields.overflow: Checked signed acquisition and release accounting.

fields.name: PeakRetainedBytes
fields.definition: Recorded largest physically acquired page extent; survives trim and disposal without history reconstruction.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum of checked backing gauge.

fields.name: SuccessfulRentCount
fields.definition: Fully initialized prepared lease publications, not attempts or incomplete initializers.
fields.overflow: Saturating event history independent of exact cleanup.

fields.name: RejectedShapeCount
fields.definition: Prepared requests exceeding slot element capacity, rejected before taking a slot or entering initialization.
fields.overflow: Saturates without changing admission behavior.

fields.name: RejectedFullCount
fields.definition: Prepared requests with no free retained slot, including after complete trim; no hidden regrowth.
fields.overflow: Saturates with sticky flag; no gauge wrap.

fields.name: InitializerFailureCount
fields.definition: Entered throwing or incomplete prepared initialization, counted once after slot rollback; invalid input is separate.
fields.overflow: Saturating lifetime history.

fields.name: ManagedBankBytes
fields.definition: Actual allocated slot-bank, page-bank and free-head element storage; excludes CLR headers, array overhead and native pages. Remains after page trim.
fields.overflow: Checked structural sum of retained bank lengths and actual element extents.

fields.name: UnusedSlotBytes
fields.definition: Full declared usable payload capacity of reusable backed slots only; excludes alignment padding and unused elements in occupied slots.
fields.overflow: Checked multiplication of exact bounded availability.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: Sticky owner-wide event-history saturation indication; gauges and peaks remain exact.
fields.overflow: Sticky, including after cleanup; exact maximum alone is not overflow.

schemas.scope: One fixed-capacity fast arena, ordinary and scoped lanes, with owned extents and registered provider capacity kept distinct. Header and backend rounding are native backing, not usable capacity or RSS.
schemas.consistency: Thread-confined complete capture. Entered initializer reservations are used and peaked before success is published; capture does not authorize old epochs or trimmed lanes.
schemas.resetPolicy: Reset clears both used gauges; scoped recycling clears scoped use only. Peaks, preparation and events survive. Trim removes available storage permanently in prepared mode; terminal physical cleanup clears backing and used gauges.
schemas.historyOverflow: Success, capacity-refusal and initializer-failure histories saturate with the shared owner flag; lane bytes, external obligations and peaks remain exact.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Stable non-address process-local arena identity across recycling, trim and closure.
fields.overflow: Checked non-wrapping owner construction.

fields.name: Lifecycle
fields.definition: Actual lifecycle independent of whether the prepared byte bounds were zero.
fields.overflow: Finite owner state without authority resurrection.

fields.name: Preparation
fields.definition: Original ordinary and scoped usable limits, unaffected by trim or failure; alignment consumes these limits.
fields.overflow: Backing extent and signed accounting checked before acquisition.

fields.name: OrdinaryUsedBytes
fields.definition: Occupied ordinary bump bytes, including alignment between ranges and entered initializer reservation; failure rolls back its cursor.
fields.overflow: Exact checked occupancy within prepared capacity.

fields.name: ScopedUsedBytes
fields.definition: Occupied scoped bump bytes including alignment; scoped recycle clears use without clearing ordinary output.
fields.overflow: Exact checked gauge within declared scoped bound.

fields.name: OrdinaryAvailableBytes
fields.definition: Current unreserved ordinary lane suffix, not total declared bytes after backing is trimmed. Closed owners expose zero reusable authority.
fields.overflow: Checked cursor difference, never a saturated history subtraction.

fields.name: ScopedAvailableBytes
fields.definition: Current scoped suffix while active. A trimmed provider lane stays unavailable after reset; no implicit reacquisition.
fields.overflow: Exact nonnegative cursor difference.

fields.name: PeakOrdinaryUsedBytes
fields.definition: Recorded maximum ordinary occupied bump bytes, including later-failed initialization and alignment.
fields.overflow: Exact capacity-bounded maximum, not successful publication reconstruction.

fields.name: PeakScopedUsedBytes
fields.definition: Recorded maximum scoped initializing-or-published use, surviving recycle and final cleanup.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum within the scoped bound.

fields.name: RetainedBytes
fields.definition: Complete physically held NAM-owned backing extents; mapped arenas count acquired headers, not provider payload. Partial mapped trim can release no headers yet.
fields.overflow: Checked acquisition/free accounting independent of lease events.

fields.name: ActiveBorrowedBytes
fields.definition: Currently addressable whole registered lane capacity, not initialized payload or read borrow count. Partial trim removes only inactive lane capacity.
fields.overflow: Checked registered range sum before publication.

fields.name: RetainedBorrowedBytes
fields.definition: Complete provider range still held by the real SafeBuffer lifetime pin, including a partially trimmed lane; becomes zero only on actual final release.
fields.overflow: Exact checked registered extent; not charged as NAM-owned backing.

fields.name: PeakRetainedBytes
fields.definition: Largest acquired complete NAM extent; owned lanes include header/backend padding, mapped lanes include the shared header allocation only.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum of checked retained-byte gauge.

fields.name: SuccessfulScratchCount
fields.definition: Complete initialized ordinary or scoped prepared publications; incomplete and throwing initializers receive no credit.
fields.overflow: Saturating history cannot interrupt real publication or cleanup.

fields.name: RejectedCapacityCount
fields.definition: Prepared reservations refused before initialization for unavailable byte bounds, including fully trimmed or partially trimmed lanes.
fields.overflow: Saturating history independent of exact lane gauges.

fields.name: InitializerFailureCount
fields.definition: Entered prepared initializers that throw or fail exact range completion; reservation is rolled back while peak is retained.
fields.overflow: Saturating event history with sticky owner flag.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: Shared owner history-saturation state, independent of tracing and exact capacity or provider obligation.
fields.overflow: Sticky through reset and terminal capture.

schemas.scope: One fast arena's optional cold-boundary retention policy. Known NAM native extents only; provider capacity, live payload, allocator overhead and RSS are not silently included.
schemas.consistency: Complete capture on the owning thread; idle means reusable whole segment, not slack within an occupied bump segment. Closed owners have no reusable idle authority.
schemas.resetPolicy: Enabled reset and scoped recycle apply the policy and record maintenance. Disposal releases storage but adds no policy-release credit. Disabled policy remains default with genuinely zero policy histories, while actual retained/idle extents remain measured.
schemas.historyOverflow: Maintenance and released-byte histories saturate with the owner flag without disrupting physical frees, exact retained/oversized gauges or preserved oversized peaks.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Same immutable arena lineage as other owner captures, not an address or policy identity.
fields.overflow: Non-wrapping owner identity construction.

fields.name: Lifecycle
fields.definition: Actual owner lifecycle; disposed physical cleanup clears gauges but does not erase policy history.
fields.overflow: Finite owner state without resurrection.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.definition: Immutable explicit opt-in; disabled is real unsupported policy application, not unsupported memory measurement.
fields.overflow: Immutable boolean.

fields.name: Policy
fields.definition: Configured usable growth ceiling and complete idle native-extent allowance; default on disabled owners. This is not a live backing budget.
fields.overflow: Signed checked nonnegative limits; ordinary ceiling at least 64.

fields.name: RetainedBytes
fields.definition: Complete physically retained NAM extents including headers and backend padding, irrespective of whether policy is enabled.
fields.overflow: Exact checked acquisition/free gauge, not histories.

fields.name: IdleBytes
fields.definition: Whole NAM-owned unused segments eligible for active-owner reuse. Occupied segment slack and closed detached storage are not idle.
fields.overflow: Checked complete extent sum bounded by actual retained backing.

fields.name: OversizedBytes
fields.definition: Actual retained complete NAM extents whose usable capacity exceeds explicit ceiling; disabled policy has a documented zero invariant.
fields.overflow: Exact checked retained subset with actual acquisition and release transitions.

fields.name: PeakOversizedBytes
fields.definition: Recorded simultaneous oversized extent maximum, surviving outlier release and disposal; not inferred from latest requested length.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum within checked acquired extents.

fields.name: MaintenanceCount
fields.definition: Enabled reset, scoped recycle and explicit policy maintenance, even when live storage prevents release; disabled application throws with no event.
fields.overflow: Saturating history does not block maintenance.

fields.name: ReleasedBytes
fields.definition: Actual complete native bytes freed by policy maintenance only; final disposal and unrelated trim cannot invent credit.
fields.overflow: Saturating lifetime sum; physical budget relief remains exact.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: Sticky owner-wide saturation flag; it may also reflect non-policy owner histories, never a substitute for missing measurement.
fields.overflow: Sticky through real release and final cleanup.
